project: Atelier — August 6th updates — W6 Category export
description:
A spreadsheet round trip letting the office assign product categories, generalised into a reusable per-brand template.

Epic: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/epics.md (Epic 6)
Architecture: _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architecture.md
Requires: W3 merged (products.category)
Blocks: nothing

userStories.title: Extract the encoding-sniffing CSV reader
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one CSV reader, so that the encoding sniff is not reimplemented.
acceptanceCriteria: decodeText and csvRows move verbatim to src/lib/csv-text.js
scripts/lib/text.js re-exports them
test/converters.test.js passes unchanged — that is the proof this was a move
npm run convert:pricing still produces a byte-identical price-lists.json
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Product sheet export with an empty Category column
userStories.description: As the office, I want a spreadsheet I can fill in, so that categorising products does not need a developer.
acceptanceCriteria: Defaults to brand atelier-textiles-nz and accepts any ?brand=
The header row is a documented contract, with Category present and empty
A stable server key is included so re-import never depends on row order
Uses the hardened CSV writer; a staff-typed name beginning = is neutralised
The filename derives from the brand slug, so nothing user-typed reaches the header
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Re-import parse and validate
userStories.description: As the office, I want to be told exactly what is wrong before anything is written.
acceptanceCriteria: A file saved by Excel on Windows (cp1252) parses correctly
An unknown category value is reported with its row number
An unmatched key is reported, not guessed
Nothing is written when any row fails
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: Apply validated categories
userStories.description: As the office, I want my edits to land.
acceptanceCriteria: All updates run in one transaction
The response reports counts changed, unchanged and skipped
Re-uploading the same file changes nothing
Gates green: `( cd atelier-api && npm run lint && npm test )`

userStories.title: CRM export and import panel
userStories.description: As the office, I want to do this from the CRM.
acceptanceCriteria: Download, then upload with a validation report shown before applying
The brand selector makes the template generalisation visible
Gates green: `( cd atelier-crm && npm test && npm run build )`
